how_to_find: Open your fork of gas-tasks-mcp on GitHub. Read the date of the newest commit on the main branch. Compare it with the commits listed here. For the Apps Script bridge, open your project, click Deploy, then Manage deployments. Read the version number and description.

versions.title: Version at first wizard release
